svg.title: All 95 of yah265's VBR rungs come within 10% of their target
svg.desc: Dot plot of VBR rate error per rung for the real-title cells, yah265 and x265.
svg.text: All 95 of yah265's VBR rungs come within 10% of their target
Achieved bitrate against the target over the whole cell, five rungs per encoder. The shaded band is yah265's ±10% limit.
achieved bitrate against the target (left is under)
